auditScope: Git blob identity/size, declaration-typing-only patch inspection; NOT Golden semantic or Core parity
notes: v1 is an immutable historical inventory. v2 records exact head Git blob identities, never silently rewrites historical pins.

No actual Golden vectors, verified Csc, Core generic source-derived HWIR, or native ToolBridge receipt is present.
Do not infer Processor top, fourth Rank slot, lane6 ownership or cross-cycle semantics from these projection filenames.
